qa: You can give that effect to such Digimon, but if the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the gained effect won't trigger.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Collision＞ ＜Fragment《3》＞ ＜Blocker＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] Until your opponent's turn ends, give 1 of their Digimon "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks." [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When Digimon attack, by trashing any 2 of this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ and +3000 DP until your turn ends.

text_sections.label: Special Play Condition
text_sections.text: DigiXros -2: 3 Digimon cards w/[Bagra Army] trait When this would be played, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each one reduces the play cost.
